input:
CURRENT SCENE:
他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

ITEMS:

[I244] 【^】一百岁时候   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: age expression needs 的 before 时候
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]
  her past correction: 他才四[-年]岁
  her past correction: 一个老人决定[-了] — her note: “决定” is a mental state verb, no了

[I245] 不小心吃了【毒的】花   correction: 毒的 → 有毒的   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 毒的 -> 有毒的 (corrected 9/11 in train)
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 他正好吃[一毒→一种有毒]的花
  her past correction: 有的花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: [是毒的花→有毒的花]

[I246] 一吃就【开始死】   correction: 开始死 → 死了   strength: error
  checker's note: death is a completed event here, not something that starts
  rule card (incorrect_story_information, Content): Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this changes a story fact; the story says <fact>.  Her terms: wrong information, problematic in coherence
  her past correction: 所以⟦他一吃，肚子就疼死了⟧ — her note: it is problematic in coherence, if 灵芝is medicine, it should not be他一吃肚子就疼死了
  her past correction: ⟦一吃夹竹桃就死⟧ — her note: it is unclear what the subject is, add “神农说：一吃夹竹桃就不舒服”, it is not “死”
  her past correction: [就疼死了→肚子/头就疼死了]

[I247] 但是生病【^】时候告诉人什么植物是药   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: time phrase needs 的 before 时候
  rule card (question_patterns, Grammar): Use 是……吗, V不V, or a Wh-question for an indirect question, not 如果. For “wh-ever…, will do that…”, repeat the Wh-word: 哪一筐……就……哪一筐.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this asks <whether/what/where>, so use <question pattern>, not 如果.  Her terms: repeated Wh-Q
  her past correction: [+是]药还是毒
  her past correction: 后来神农写书了哪些植物是药[-，]哪些植物是毒
  her past correction: 虽然有的[-他]邻居一吃了植物就生病

[I248] 什么【植物】是毒   correction: 植物 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 他们吃[毒→有毒的]植物

[I249] 什么植物【是毒】   correction: 是毒 → 有毒   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 是毒 -> 有毒 (corrected 14/15 in train)
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 有的花[是毒→有毒]

items.explanation: Use 的 before 时候 in an age time phrase: 一百岁的时候.
Here the flower needs an adjective form. 毒 is a noun, so use 有毒的花.
This changes a story fact: the story says he died after eating the poisonous flower, so use 死了, not 开始死.
Use 的 before 时候 in this time phrase: 生病的时候.
It would be more natural to avoid repeating 植物: 什么植物是药，什么有毒.
Here the structure needs an Adj. 毒 is a noun, so say 有毒.
